nodes.label: startContainer / runner.run
nodes.desc: startContainer (L381) loads config.json, builds the container, then runner.run (L223) dispatches Start/Run

nodes.label: CreateLibcontainerConfig

nodes.label: libcontainer.Create
nodes.desc: Create (L35) validates the id, makes the state dir and a cgroup manager (L58), returns *Container

nodes.label: Container.Start / Run

nodes.label: Container.start
nodes.desc: start (L318) creates the exec fifo, builds the parent process (L343) and calls parent.start (L377)

nodes.label: newParentProcess
nodes.desc: newParentProcess (L496) re-execs /proc/self/exe init (L530) with _LIBCONTAINER_* pipe fds

nodes.label: initProcess.start

nodes.label: runc init
nodes.desc: Init (L106) runs in the re-exec'd child and hands off through startInitialization (L128)

nodes.label: prepareRootfs
nodes.desc: prepareRootfs (L170) mounts every entry, pivots root and jails the process inside the rootfs
